procedure: Compare applications, interfaces and service owners
expected_result: Every in-scope integration has a source, destination, owner and retirement decision

procedure: Inspect versioned payload, timeout and retry contract
expected_result: Required fields, error handling and idempotency rules are agreed

procedure: Send duplicate message and force a transient failure
expected_result: One business transaction results after retries; failures remain visible

procedure: Reconcile one complete business cycle across old and new systems
expected_result: Source IDs and financial/control totals reconcile with no unexplained critical differences

procedure: Rehearse rollback and verify operating coverage
expected_result: Restore path and responsibility are accepted before migration authority is granted

procedure: Review retention and dependency clearance before retirement
expected_result: No live dependency remains; retention, access removal and disposal approvals are recorded
